column1: # apps.tsv - single source of truth for the offline app backup.
# Tab-separated. One row = one downloadable installer file.
#   ext     rpm | deb | dmg | pkg | msi | exe | AppImage | zip | tar.gz | tar.xz
#   source  where to fetch from, one of:
#             gh:owner/repo:REGEX    -> newest GitHub release asset whose name matches REGEX
#             ghtag:owner/repo:URL   -> newest GitHub tag substituted into URL
#             dir:BASE|SEG|...|FILE  -> newest matching file in a directory index
#             page:URL|REGEX         -> first absolute link on a download page
# Apps that ship ONLY through distro repos or version-pinned URLs are listed in
# README.md instead - install those with the OS scripts in
